vectors.spec: /spec/1.0/events/subagents#lifecycle: a producer MUST NOT reuse the id of an invocation that has already finished in this run (a second terminal)
vectors.notes: Wrapped: RUN_STARTED prepended. Hook test whose stream is itself non-conformant: SUBAGENT_ERROR already closed s1, so the reference's own verifier rejects the SUBAGENT_FINISHED that follows (the reducer-only test never runs verification). The hook calls are TS-only; the [error then finish split] variants state what apply keeps from each lifecycle event on a conformant stream.
